description.fun: A robot stag that looks like Virizion from the future, with a glossy metal body and long horns. The glowing parts on its forehead and leaves become shining blades, sharp enough to slice large trees and boulders into thin strips; the Pokédex says it juliennes them. When it sleeps it switches itself off and its red glow goes dark.
description.guide: A Grass and Psychic-type Paradox Pokémon, said to be either a future relative of Virizion or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It was added to Pokémon Scarlet and Violet in a February 2023 update and can be caught only once per save file. Its counterpart is Walking Wake.
description.tagline: A robot Virizion that juliennes trees with glowing blades
